text:
Sam K: Heads up — planning to deploy console v2.14 to prod at 16:30 PT (in ~10m). Quick checklist: CDN invalidation, cache TTL adjustments for static assets, smoke checks for login and /api/chat, and rollback readiness. @Jordan L can you own the deploy? @Maya P can you run invalidation after the pipeline finishes?

Jordan L: I can take the deploy. Plan: tag -> pipeline -> verify health endpoints -> promote. I'll start at :30. Which health endpoints should we check?

Sam K: Primary smoke checks: `/healthz` (app), `/login` (UI flow), `/api/chat/health` (LLM proxy). Watch 5xx rate and latency p50/p95. If errors >5% in the first 5m we rollback. I'll monitor metrics.

Maya P: I can handle CDN invalidation. Need distribution IDs and paths. I'll run CloudFront invalidation ~2m post-deploy and do Fastly purge for the manifest if it looks stale.

Rory D: One note — I pushed an edge header tweak a few minutes ago to reduce asset TTLs. Specifically set `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60` for `/console/manifest.json` to avoid stale bundles. If anyone's still relying on the old TTL we should be aware.

Sam K: Distribution info: CloudFront distro `ABCD1234`. Paths to invalidate: `/console/*` and `/assets/*`. Fastly service id `fsty_9876` — purge key `/console/manifest.json` if needed.

Jordan L: Got it. Rollback plan: revert to tag `v2.13` and re-run pipeline, then re-invalidate CDN with the same paths. I have the revert command in the release runbook. If prod errors spike I'll trigger rollback and post here.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline job 789 queued for console-service tag v2.14. Status: running -> will post updates.

Jordan L: Pipeline started, building image and running migrations (no DB schema changes, just a config flag). ETA ~4m.

Maya P: Ready on invalidation. Command I'll run after the bot reports success: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths '/console/*' '/assets/*'` and if manifest is stale then `fastly purge fsty_9876 /console/manifest.json`.

Jordan L: Deploy finished, switching traffic to new version. deploy-bot: job 789 -> success. :rocket:

Sam K: Starting smoke checks now. /healthz 200, login flow loads main bundle and auth works. Watching /api/chat.

Jordan L: Seeing a handful of 502s from /api/chat in the first 30s (approx 3%). Watching.

Rory D: I'm seeing increased p95 latency to the LLM proxy — could be cold caches on the proxy nodes. Recommend waiting 2m before deciding rollback unless error rate climbs.

Sam K: Agreed. Error rate holding at 3.5% and counting — under threshold. Continuing to observe.

Maya P: Running CloudFront invalidation now: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths '/console/*' '/assets/*'` — invalidation submitted :white_check_mark:

Jordan L: Error rate dropping. /api/chat 200s now, p95 trending down. Looks like a short cold-start effect.

Sam K: Confirming login flow and admin routes OK. No action required.

Rory D: Fastly purge ran for manifest key as a precaution: `fastly purge fsty_9876 /console/manifest.json` — manifest updated.

Jordan L: Promoted release to 100% traffic. No rollback needed. Great work everyone. :tada:

Sam K: I'll leave metrics watching for the next 30m and then close the thread. If anyone sees client-cache related oddities ping here.

Maya P: Thanks — will monitor CDN invalidation status and report if any edges still serve old content.

deploy-bot: Notification: all checks green for release job 789.

Sam K: All good on my side after 30m. Closing the loop — v2.14 is live. :white_check_mark:
